hero.title: Keep store stock accurate every day
hero.body: Record receiving, sales, damaged goods, and stocktakes in one place. Admins, staff, and owners each get the right role — no mismatched spreadsheets.
hero.imageAlt: Hello Stock dashboard in a stockroom

stock.title: Receiving & sales
stock.body: Every inbound and outbound move gets a transaction code. Stock updates automatically, with a clear trail for audits and closing.

team.title: Work together
team.body: Staff record operations, admins manage access, owners read reports. One stock dataset, three clear roles.

damage.title: Damaged goods & QC
damage.body: Report damage with photos. Choose hold, return, or dispose — everything is saved so nothing disappears in manual notes.

opname.title: Stocktake & adjustments
opname.body: Match physical counts with the system. Variances are saved with reasons — month-end closing is no longer guesswork.

pricing.title: Plans that fit your store
pricing.body: Start free for small shops, then move to Store or Business as your team and locations grow. Billed monthly, cancel anytime.

free.name: Free
free.blurb: For small shops starting clean stock control.

shop.name: Store
shop.blurb: For daily operations with admins and staff.

business.name: Business
business.blurb: For multi-location teams that need more control.

cta.title: Open stock from anywhere
cta.body: Use a browser in the store or office. Create an account, or try the admin, staff, and owner demos first.

data.title: Reports you can use
data.body: See opening–closing summaries by SKU, download CSV, and manage QC photo retention. Your inventory data stays in your hands.

apps.title: All inventory modules, one Hello Stock
apps.body: Products, receiving, sales, damaged goods, stocktakes, and reports — daily store flow without switching apps.

prabowo.quote: Ingredient receiving, outbound moves, and MBG distribution reports now sit in one flow. Field teams no longer reconcile numbers at the end of the day.

gibran.quote: Village co-op admins and staff work in the same system. Stocktakes are faster, and variances show up earlier.

bahlil.quote: Operational inventory is tracked per transaction. Summaries and reports are ready without waiting on manual recaps.

footer.brand: Hello Stock helps stores record daily stock: tracked transactions, separated roles, and reports ready to read.
footer.tryBody: Start free, or sign in with the admin, staff, or owner demo.

guide.title: Hello Stock guide
guide.lead: Practical steps for inventory modules: products, receiving, sales, damaged goods, stocktakes, and reports.

mulai.title: Quick start
steps: Create an account, or sign in with a demo (admin, staff, or owner).
From the Dashboard, review stock summaries and recent activity.
Add products, then record daily receiving and sales.

peran.title: Roles in Hello Stock
steps: Admin: manage users and all modules.
Staff: handle receiving, sales, damaged goods, and stocktakes.
Owner: monitor reports and stock condition (read-only).

stok.title: Products & stock flow
steps: Add products in Products (name, SKU, unit, opening stock).
Record outbound goods in Sales — stock updates automatically.

qc.title: Damaged goods & stocktakes
steps: Report damaged goods and upload QC photos when needed.
Set disposition on the detail page.
Run a stocktake during physical counts so data matches the warehouse.

laporan.title: Reports
steps: Open an SKU detail page to see stock movement.
Download CSV when you need to take data outside the app.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Questions about plans, demos, or how to use Hello Stock? Send a short message — we read every one.
contact.name: Name
contact.note: Or try a demo account on the sign-in page.
contact.sent: Message saved. This is a local demo, so no real email is sent yet.

legal.title: Terms & privacy
legal.lead: A short summary of how Hello Stock uses account and store inventory data for this demo product.
terms: You are responsible for the account and data entered into the system.
Demo accounts are for feature trials only, not sensitive production data.
Features and plans may change as the product develops.
privacy: Login and inventory data are used to run the app (sessions, stock, reports).
QC photos are stored according to retention settings in the system.
We do not sell your store data to third parties for advertising.
legal.contactBody: For questions about data or accounts, open the Contact page.

security.title: Hello Stock security
security.lead: Access is limited by role, transactions leave a trail, and inventory data stays under your store’s control.
access: Admins manage users and all modules.
Staff handle daily operations within their permissions.
Owners read summaries and reports without changing operational data.
trail: Receiving and sales include transaction codes.
Stocktake adjustments and damage dispositions are saved with reasons.
Reports can be exported to CSV for internal audits.
security.statusBody: Monitor system availability on the Status page.
